provenance: PRODUCT_APPROVED (values frozen by the Wave 2 brief and the approved C2 package)
checksumAlgorithm: FNV-1a 64-bit over the key-sorted canonical JSON form of the fixture object; identical in Node and the browser
checksumExposedAs: the fixtureChecksum field of every __C2_READY descriptor
checksumAssertion: tools/measure.mjs and tools/run_negative_matrix.mjs compare the browser checksum with the Node checksum before every capture and every negative case; a mismatch aborts the run.

testOnlyReferences.note: All references are test-only literals. No production identifier, PAN, CVV, payment OTP or PII appears in this package.

dynamicRegionsExcludedFromVisualComparis: the hold countdown value in s33-hold (pinned to 07:12 in every other s33 state)
the session elapsed clock in the live-room header (pinned to 12:04 / 45:00)
the generatedAtUtc date field of MEASURED_GEOMETRY_RESULTS.json

privacy.rule: No canary may appear in location.href, document.cookie, localStorage, sessionStorage or the rendered DOM. Asserted by NEG-PRIV-01..04.
privacy.storageWritten: none — the reference writes no cookie and no web storage at all
privacy.networkRequests: none — fonts are embedded, all assets are relative file:// paths
